verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.customer.io/llms.txt, and the pack also shows an llms-full.txt, per-section llms.txt files (ai, messaging, accounts, integrations), a marketing-site llms.txt, Markdown versions of doc pages, and an OpenAPI spec at the conventional path. Agent-oriented material includes CLI skills that teach assistants to drive the CLI and a Claude plugin. missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
